package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for manual_required_checks_after_validate_tags_available: Handlers that re-check required fields manually even though struct-tag validation already exists.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type CreateAccountRequest struct {
	Name  string `json:"name" validate:"required"`
	Email string `json:"email" validate:"required,email"`
	Phone string `json:"phone"`
}

func CreateAccountHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req CreateAccountRequest
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)

	if req.Name == "" {
		http.Error(w, "name is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if req.Email == "" {
		http.Error(w, "email is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
		"name":  req.Name,
		"email": req.Email,
	})
}
